description: Elimination cutscene (cartoon/stickman, bloodless, comic) that plays at the end of ALL THREE rounds, each time the round's final match is submitted AND the round is settled (no unresolved tie). A group of cartoon stickman 'throwers' toss the ELIMINATED stickmen (one per cut player, each LABELED with the player's name from the engine view) into a GIANT FURNACE (big glowing furnace mouth reusing the fire gradient), Looney-Tunes style with a comic *POOF*. The overlay must be SKIPPABLE (visible Skip button + click-anywhere + Esc), respect prefers-reduced-motion (static/instant summary instead of the animated toss, still skippable), and honor the Pause-world preference where sensible. After skip or completion, the user lands on the normal resultFullscreen standings. Frontend-only; no engine.py/app.py changes.
steps: Identify the eliminated players per stage from the engine view (already available, no server change): round1 -> view.round1.rows filtered to status==='CUT'; round2 -> view.round2.rows filtered to status==='CUT'; final -> view.final.rows filtered to rank>3 (non-podium; the top 3 podium are NOT thrown). Pull {name} from those rows. Write a small helper (e.g. eliminatedNames(key)) that returns the correctly ordered list of names for a stage.

Hook the trigger into the existing end-of-round flow in static/app.js. In openMatchResult(key,match): the end-of-round moment is resultFinal=(match===meta.count-1)&&v.games.every(g=>g.ready). ONLY play the cutscene when resultFinal is true AND view[key].complete is true (round settled, no outstanding TIE). If a tie is unresolved (view[key].complete false / rows contain a TIE), do NOT play it - fall through to the normal resultFullscreen tie/extra-game flow. If eliminatedNames(key) is empty, skip the cutscene gracefully and show the standings directly.

Implement the cutscene as a full-screen overlay layer (its own element, e.g. #cutscene added to static/index.html, or a dedicated layer inside #result-dialog) that plays BEFORE revealing the resultFullscreen standings. Approach: when triggered, show the cutscene overlay first; on completion OR skip, dismiss the overlay and reveal/return to the normal resultFullscreen in #result-dialog (reuse the existing openMatchResult/renderResult path so standings, tie flow, Undo, save controls all keep working unchanged).

Build the visual with inline SVG/CSS and the Web Animations API (el.animate) + requestAnimationFrame already used in app.js. Draw cartoon stick figures: a group of 'thrower' stickmen and one eliminated stickman per cut player, each labeled with the player's name (escape names with the existing esc()). Animate a goofy comic arc toss into a giant furnace whose mouth reuses the fire gradient (url(#fire) look); add a puff/POOF and optional *CLANG* comic text. Bloodless and non-graphic. Keep decorative SVG bits aria-hidden; give the overlay an accessible label and a visible Skip button.

Skippable + accessible: a visible Skip button, plus click-anywhere on the overlay and Esc dismiss it immediately and proceed to the standings. Add an Esc/keydown handler scoped to the cutscene that does not permanently trap focus and does not break the existing #screen-dialog / #result-dialog cancel handlers. Ensure focus returns sanely to the result dialog (its .result-close is focused by the existing openMatchResult path). Provide a single dismiss function (e.g. endCutscene()) used by Skip, click, Esc, and natural completion so there is exactly one code path to the standings.

Reduced-motion + pause: if reducedMotion() is true, replace the animated toss with a STATIC/instant summary (the furnace with the named eliminated figures and an 'ELIMINATED: name1, name2' caption), still skippable, no vibration. While the cutscene runs, suppress the ambient world shake from FEAT-002 (set the shared cutscene-active guard so the ambient loop does not vibrate the screen). Honor the Pause-world preference where sensible (do not run ambient shake under it).

Do NOT regress existing behavior: non-final match submit still opens the cumulative popup; the end-of-round fullscreen standings still render after the cutscene; extra-game/tie flow is untouched (cutscene never fires on an unresolved tie); Undo, clears, To Die sit-out draw, and backups all still work. closeResult() must still fully reset result state.

Extend tests/test_ui.cjs (vm sandbox + fetch stub + click() helper; note matchMedia currently returns {matches:true}=reduced-motion-on). Add assertions: (a) submitting the FINAL match of each stage (round1 match index 4, round2 index 7, final index 9) with a settled round triggers the cutscene showing EXACTLY the correct eliminated names - round1 CUT rows, round2 CUT rows, final rank>3 - and does NOT trigger on a non-final match; (b) with an unresolved tie fixture (reuse cut_tie_state like FEAT-003's existing tie test) the cutscene does NOT play and the normal fullscreen 'EXTRA GAMES NEEDED' path shows; (c) the cutscene is skippable - invoking the skip/dismiss path removes the overlay and leaves the user on the resultFullscreen standings; (d) under the stubbed reduced-motion condition the animated path is replaced by the static summary (assert the summary/caption markup or a reduced-motion branch flag). Build stage fixtures via python3 -c one-liners against engine.evaluate like the existing test does. Keep all existing assertions passing.

Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests and node tests/test_ui.cjs; both must stay green. Live probe (script file, single invocation) to confirm the page still serves and app.js parses (curl / and /app.js -> 200).
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the final match of To Live, To Die, and Rebirth (when the round is settled) plays the cartoon furnace cutscene showing exactly the right eliminated names: round1 CUT rows, round2 CUT rows, final rank>3.
The cutscene does NOT fire on a non-final match, and does NOT fire when a tie is unresolved (view[key].complete false) - the existing extra-game/tie fullscreen path shows instead.
If no players would be thrown, the cutscene is skipped gracefully and standings show directly.

The overlay is skippable via a visible Skip button, click-anywhere, and Esc; after dismiss or natural completion the user is on the normal resultFullscreen standings, with focus not permanently trapped.

Under prefers-reduced-motion a static/instant furnace summary with an 'ELIMINATED: names' caption replaces the animated toss, still skippable; the ambient world shake is suppressed while the cutscene runs.
Decorative SVG bits are aria-hidden; the overlay has an accessible label; existing dialog focus/cancel behavior still works.

Existing flows intact: non-final cumulative popup, end-of-round fullscreen standings, tie/extra-game fold, Undo, clears, To Die sit-out draw, and backup restore all still work. No engine.py/app.py changes; schema stays version 4; old backups load.

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests ends OK and node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 including the new cutscene assertions (correct names per stage, no-trigger on non-final/tie, skippable, reduced-motion static summary).
verification: bash /projects/sandbox/probe_cutscenes.sh (single invocation; confirm / and /app.js return 200 so app.js parses)
findings: Implemented frontend-only (static/index.html, static/app.js, static/style.css; README.md touched for docs; engine.py/app.py unchanged, schema stays v4). index.html: added a hidden full-screen #cutscene overlay (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby=#cutscene-label, tabindex=-1) containing #cutscene-stage (the inline SVG), a #cutscene-caption (aria-live), a visible #cutscene-skip button, and an aria-hidden hint; decorative SVG is aria-hidden. app.js: eliminatedNames(key) reads the engine view (round1/round2 -> rows status==='CUT'; final -> rows rank>3, podium rank<=3 spared), ordered by rank. buildCutscene() renders cartoon stickman throwers + one labelled stickman per cut player (name via esc(), carried as data-name + <text>) + a giant furnace whose mouth reuses the fire gradient (local #furnace-fire defs copy so it is self-contained). playCutscene(names) returns a Promise, sets the shared FEAT-002 cutsceneActive guard + stopWorldBlasts() to suppress the ambient shake, shows the overlay, and either animates the goofy toss arc via el.animate([...]) + a POOF (motion on) or shows a STATIC 'ELIMINATED: name1, name2' caption (reducedMotion()); empty name list resolves immediately. ONE dismiss path endCutscene() (Skip button, click-anywhere on #cutscene, Esc capture-phase keydown, and natural setTimeout completion all call it) clears timers, removes the keydown listener (so focus is never trapped and the #result-dialog/#screen-dialog cancel handlers are untouched), hides the overlay, clears cutsceneActive, and resolves the gate. Trigger hooked INSIDE openMatchResult: when resultFinal===true AND v.complete===true AND eliminatedNames(key).length, it `await playCutscene(names)` BEFORE opening #result-dialog, so the existing renderResult/resultFullscreen/closeResult/tie-extra/Undo/save paths are reused verbatim after the cutscene. An unresolved tie (v.complete false) falls through to the normal 'EXTRA GAMES NEEDED' fullscreen with no cutscene; non-final submits still open the cumulative popup. style.css: .cutscene overlay (fixed, z-index 60, radial furnace backdrop), furnace-flicker + cutscene-poof keyframes, and a reduced-motion block that forces the flicker/toss/POOF off (static summary only). tests/test_ui.cjs: added a flushMicro() helper (drains microtasks so a click handler that awaits the flush/save stubs reaches the synchronous cutsceneActive flag WITHOUT firing the sandbox's never-firing setTimeout). Updated the existing settled final-match submits (round1 idx4, final idx9) to assert the cutscene fires with EXACTLY the right labelled names (round1 CUT, final rank>3) and that advancing/podium players are NOT thrown, then dismiss via endCutscene() and continue to the fullscreen; asserted the round2 tie submit does NOT set cutsceneActive. Added a dedicated FEAT-003 block: eliminatedNames per stage, non-final submit does not trigger, the skippable single endCutscene() dismiss path (overlay hidden + flag cleared + standings shown), the reduced-motion static 'ELIMINATED:' caption, and empty-list immediate resolve. Verification: node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 (all section lines print incl. the new FEAT-003 cutscene line); python3 -m unittest discover -s tests => 44 OK; probe_cutscenes.sh => / /app.js /style.css all HTTP 200, world layer + world-toggle present.
